Done. Here's the s4 verification report for the 2026-06-15 overnight run.

## Stage 4 — Verify & Edge Cases: COMPLETE ✅

**What this run produced (s1–s3):** Backend re-verified converged (0 fixes), and the frontend tablet-768px sweep surfaced **two genuine bugs**, both fixed:
- `55d5df6` — Lead table hid the Address column at ≤768px (left only badge columns; address is the lead identifier here)
- `db43990` — Materials category tabs were clipped inside an `overflow:hidden` container at ≤768px with no way to reach them

**My verification (Playwright @768px and @375px):**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Lead Address column @768px | ✅ cols 1–5 (incl. Address) visible, 6+ hidden, page overflow 0, table fits 712px |
| Lead table @375px | ✅ degrades cleanly, no overflow |
| Materials tabs scroll @768px | ✅ `overflow-x:auto`+`no-scrollbar`, scrolls to reveal Delivery, search pinned right, overflow 0 |
| Materials @375px | ✅ still scrollable, no overflow |
| Empty state (`/leads?search=zzz…`) | ✅ "No leads found" + helper text, "0 leads", no overflow |
| Bottom tab bar @768/375 (Run 46 fix) | ✅ still rendering |
| Console errors | only transient mount-race 401s (data loads fine); Materials 0 errors |
| `npx vite build` | ✅ clean, 7.55s |

**No regressions, no new bugs.** Both fixes work and didn't break adjacent functionality. Per the QA charter ("if it works, leave it alone"), s4 made no code changes → no commit. Verification screenshots saved (`qa-s4-leads-768-verify.jpeg`, `qa-s4-materials-768-verify.jpeg`).

I updated `overnight_resume.md` for the next run: the 768px sweep is paying off — the next-highest-value work is finishing it on the remaining non-Dashboard pages (Invoices, Tasks, Calendar, Reports, Estimates, Pipeline, etc.), then a11y/axe-core and keyboard nav (both still never attempted). Backend stays off-limits (converged 7+ runs).
